## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:spec`, `pm:blocked` on PR #23315. The v18 stored preview lists the two families it still leaves out, so no row passes the preview and is then refused after the upgrade

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T18:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 `target:v18`:** this is the report channel of the #23269 / #23270 / #23271 family (all p1). Ruling A on objectstack-ai/cloud#2866 puts tenant databases through the platform's upgrade, and the maintainer's lane rule makes whatever blocks cloud's v18 upgrade high priority. A row the preview passes and the upgraded runtime refuses is exactly what that preview exists to prevent.
- **Lane:** `domain:spec`. The preview's detectors and the step-18 D3 entries are spec-owned, and the family is in the same seat's hands. `Clause-②: no`: the preview lists more, and no door accepts more.
- **Why blocked:** PR #23315 is the detector list and report channel this card extends, and the card names that order.

Blocked-by: #23315
Restart-when: PR #23315 has merged.

- **Direction: the card's "Wanted", as written.**
  - Item 1: the D3 entry's scope covers the page components whose `data` is `ViewDataSchema` (or a sibling entry does), listed by page and component.
  - Item 2: the stored-flow pass runs `registerFlow`'s whole validation rather than one judge at a time. A refusal added later, #23260's value arm included, is then listed with no second change.
  - Pins per item, each with a negative control.

## Unlock scan: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. `Blocked-by: #23315` is satisfied: PR #23315 merged as `572ecfb2ef`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T20:59Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Re-derived at this act:** the merge was at 2026-10-13T20:45Z. The preview's detector list and report channel this card extends are now on `main`.

- **At claim:** if #23260 (PR #23319) has landed, item 2's whole-validation pass also covers its value arm. If not, the pass must not hard-code the judges.

File surface (at `origin/main` `688a39d77` or later, which carries PR #23315 `572ecfb2e` and PR #23319 `ca0bdbcca`; stop on breach and explain in the report):
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts` (the detector list PR #23315 added) and its tests;
- the step-18 D3 entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts` (its scope), or a NEW sibling entry file for the page components;
- the stored-flow pass: `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` (`canonicalizeStoredFlow`) and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts`, so the pass runs `registerFlow`'s whole validation;
- generated projections through the generators, and one `.changeset/23317-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: open PR #23345 (#23298, `os-support-ai`) edits it. If the pass needs it, the dev stops and reports.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate). A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review by an isolated subagent precedes the queue.
Clause-②: no (the preview lists more; no door accepts more), per triage
Responsibility: the v18 stored preview (`os migrate meta --stored`), which still passes two shapes the v18 doors refuse | none: the rows load and are then refused at rehydration or boot with no listing | every deployment upgrading to v18 with a stored page whose component binds the retired API source, or a stored flow carrying any other `registerFlow` refusal (cloud's v18 upgrade, ruling A on objectstack-ai/cloud#2866)
Thread-read: 6155083387
Serial constraints cleared (all open PRs' file lists read in this act; the lane's queue re-read in this act; this card is an open p1 `target:v18`, and the older one, #23267, went to the decision box in this seat's act):
- PR #23315 (the family) and PR #23319 (#23260's value arm) are landed, so item 2's whole-validation pass covers #23260's refusal, as the unlock asks.
- Open PR #23345 edits `protocol.ts`, fenced off above.
- #23338 (two other step-18 entries' text, in `pm:queue`) touches neither file of this surface.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `os-justin`. The PR carries `Fixes #23317`.

## ✅ ACCEPT: PR #23356 at `ac768f1d5` (`Fixes #23317`). Next: the contract-tier review, then the queue

`domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H` · 2026-10-14T01:00Z · holder of claim `6156647772`. Report: `6158463913`. Thread-read: the report.

**Read on GitHub:** a draft against `main`, assigned to `os-justin`. Line 1 `Fixes #23317`, line 2 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. 13 files, +834 / −125. `protocol.ts` is untouched, as fenced. CI was still running at this read.

**Triage's direction (`6152829172`), as ruled:**
- **Item 1:** the `view-data-api-provider-retired` detector also walks stored pages. It lists every component whose own `ComponentPropsMap` row refuses its `data` with the retirement's prescription, by page, component and position, with headers withheld. The door's own judge decides, as PR #23315's detectors do. The measurement found four components, not two: `object-grid`, `object-map`, `object-gantt` and `object-tree`. The D3 entry's scope now names them.
- **Item 2:** `registerFlow`'s four post-parse checks return their refusal and sites through one ordered list, `registrationChecks`, instead of each throwing. `registerFlow` throws the first refusal with a message the dev reports byte-identical. `canonicalizeStoredFlow` lists every site as a `registerFlow` TODO and skips a site a chain TODO already names. A refusal added to that list later is listed with no second change.

**Premises the measurement moved, accepted:**
- **Zone 2 assumption 1 is partly disproved.** A stored page carrying the binding is not refused at rehydration or at the save door: `PageSchema` accepts it, and the props gate is CLI-only. The TODO's fate therefore says the page loads and saves, while `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` refuse it in source. That is the truth, and the open runtime door is now its own card, #23357.
- **#23260's value arm** (the unlock `6155083387`) is refused inside `FlowSchema.parse` itself, before any registration check. So the stored pass already reports such a flow as `failed`, with its refusal, and nothing in item 2 needs to change for it. Put to the contract review.
- **`Clause-②` flips to `yes (widening)`,** as the dispatch's Zone 1 orders when a published output widens. Every door is unchanged. What widens:
  - `ConversionTodoNotice.conversionId` can name `registerFlow`;
  - `canonicalizeStoredFlow(...).todos` also carries registration refusals;
  - the `applyConversions` `onTodo` sink also receives page-component TODOs.

  The changeset is `minor` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/service-automation`, naming each member.

**Evidence accepted:**
- **Suites:** service-automation 2,481 tests after the merge of `main`; the whole spec project (670 files) and `test:repo`; the metadata-protocol and runtime narrowings, declared. Typecheck exit 0 in all four packages.
- **New pins**, each item with negative controls and a door-agreement pin in both directions: `refused-shapes.test.ts` +14, `canonicalize-stored-flow.test.ts` +23, the stored-migration protocol test +1.
- **Ablations, each red as predicted, each restored to HEAD:** A1 the page judge (7 red), A2 the props-row judge (3), A3 the registration listing (13), A4 the dedupe (2).
- **Gates:** 114 derived, all 114 exit 0 on `ac768f1d5`, reconciled by `--ran`.

**Deviations accepted:**
- **Surface beyond the claim, each forced by a measurement:**
  - one foreign-vocabulary ledger row in `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts`;
  - docblocks in `conversions/types.ts` and `contracts/automation-service.ts`;
  - the `--stored` row in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`;
  - one test that called the private config-key validator.
- The shared validation is an instance method, not a module function, because the checks read live engine state.
- `todos` is computed once, on first read, so the save door and the cold-boot sync keep their prior cost.
- **Serial with #23316 (`6157679610`):** the branch heads merge cleanly; the joint typecheck of the merged tree is not measured. The PR body says the second PR to queue merges `main` and re-runs the automation suite and the contract gates.

**Report items:**
- A stored page component's `data` with the retired `api` source is accepted at the runtime save door and boot, and objectui still sends the request with its stored headers: filed #23357. Its renderer half is already carried by objectstack-ai/objectui#12325.
- At a component's `data`, the props gate prints `ViewDataSchema`'s own prescription, which names `view.data.provider`. Wording only: Acceptance notes.
